articles.title: Objectionable Song Triggers Clash During Wedding Procession in Aligarh Village
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension flared late Tuesday night in Sunana village under Jawan Police Station area of Aligarh after two communities clashed over an alleged caste-inciting song played during a wedding procession.

body.html:
Tension flared late Tuesday night in Sunana village under Jawan Police Station area of Aligarh after two communities clashed over an alleged caste-inciting song played during a wedding procession.

According to police, the procession had arrived from Palwal and was heading to the residence of Pappan, a Scheduled Caste resident. As the procession passed through a Thakur-dominated locality, a युवक allegedly played an objectionable song on a mobile phone connected to a DJ system.

Locals objected to the song, leading to a heated argument that soon escalated into verbal abuse and stone-pelting from both sides. Bricks and stones were reportedly thrown, damaging some houses and vehicles in the procession. However, no injuries were reported.

On receiving information, police from Jawan police station, along with senior officials, rushed to the spot with a heavy force. The situation was brought under control, and the wedding procession was escorted to the bride’s house under police protection. The ‘saat pheras’ ceremony was conducted peacefully amid tight security.

Additional forces have been deployed in the village to prevent further tension.

SP City Mrigank Shekhar Pathak said prima facie the dispute was triggered by a provocative song played via mobile DJ. He stated that police are identifying those who attempted to disturb communal harmony and assured that strict legal action will be taken against the culprits.

articles.title: Ferrari Loses Control in Jubilee Hills, 5 Injured After Chain Collision Near Balakrishna’s Residence
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A high-end car accident on Road No. 45 in Jubilee Hills left five persons injured on Sunday morning. The incident occurred around 10:30 am on February 22, 2026, when a red Ferrari California T (TS 07 HK 8797) was travelling from Journalist Colony towards Kondapur.

body.html:
A high-end car accident on Road No. 45 in Jubilee Hills left five persons injured on Sunday morning.

The incident occurred around 10:30 am on February 22, 2026, when a red Ferrari California T (TS 07 HK 8797) was travelling from Journalist Colony towards Kondapur. Near the residence of actor Nandamuri Balakrishna, the driver allegedly lost control of the vehicle.

According to police, the Ferrari rammed into an electric pole on the road divider, crossed over to the opposite carriageway and collided head-on with a Tata Altroz. The impact triggered a chain reaction, damaging another car and a two-wheeler.

Five people, including the Ferrari driver Kranthi Reddy (30) and his wife, sustained minor injuries. They were shifted to nearby private hospitals for treatment.

Police said the car was being driven by Kranthi Reddy, a businessman and son of the registered owner, E. Venkata Raja Reddy. He tested negative for alcohol.

The driver reportedly claimed brake and steering failure. Police are examining the vehicle’s data recorder (black box) as part of the investigation. A case has been registered under Section 281 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for rash and negligent driving.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Fake ₹500 Note Racket Busted in Bulandshahr; 3 Arrested with Printer and 26,000 Notes
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in Bulandshahr have arrested three persons for allegedly printing and circulating counterfeit currency in rural markets and animal fairs.

body.html:
Police in Bulandshahr have arrested three persons for allegedly printing and circulating counterfeit currency in rural markets and animal fairs.

The accused — Bhupendra Yadav, Rakesh Yadav and Kunwarpal — were apprehended in a joint operation conducted by Narora Police Station and the district SWAT team.

According to police, the trio used a colour printer to manufacture fake ₹500 notes at home and circulated them in crowded village markets and Paith (animal) markets. In one instance, counterfeit notes were allegedly passed to a vegetable vendor.

During the raid, police recovered ₹12,000 in counterfeit notes and ₹14,000 in half-printed fake currency. A note-printing printer, three mobile phones and a motorcycle were also seized from their possession.

After completing legal formalities, the accused were produced before a court and remanded to judicial custody.

Further investigation is underway to ascertain the scale of circulation and whether more persons are involved.

#Bulandshahr #FakeCurrency #UPPolice #NaroraPolice #CrimeNews #CounterfeitNotes #SWATAction #BreakingNews

articles.title: Reel Goes Wrong? Kanpur Constable’s Kiss Sparks Row After Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video from Kanpur has gone viral showing a police constable publicly kissing a transgender person while she was recording a reel near Anandeshwar Temple under Gwaltoli police station limits.

body.html:
A video from Kanpur has gone viral showing a police constable publicly kissing a transgender person while she was recording a reel near Anandeshwar Temple under Gwaltoli police station limits.

The incident reportedly took place on Sunday in the parking area near the temple, where a large number of devotees had gathered following Mahashivratri celebrations. Police personnel were on patrol to manage security arrangements.

According to information, the transgender individual was walking ahead of the police team and making a reel, singing the song, “Chhaila Babu to kaisa Dildar nikla… Chor samjhi thi main, thanedaar nikla…” During the recording, a constable approached her and kissed her on the cheek. The video was later uploaded from an Instagram account named “Smarty Kaushal,” showing several policemen patrolling in the background.

The clip quickly went viral on social media, drawing mixed reactions, with some users objecting to the constable’s conduct while on duty.

After the video gained traction, a user identified as “sandeepkumar120799,” allegedly the constable, commented on the post requesting its deletion. He wrote that he was facing problems and that his job was at stake, urging the transgender person to remove the video. When the video was not deleted, the constable reportedly deactivated his Instagram account.

Colonelganj ACP Amit Kumar Chaurasia stated that the constable is not posted at Gwaltoli police station and may have been deployed there for duty. He added that the authenticity and exact location of the viral video are being verified and an inquiry is underway.

#Kanpur #ViralVideo #UPPolice #SocialMediaRow #Mahashivratri #PoliceOnDuty #BreakingNews

articles.title: AIIMS Doctor from Northeast Molested in Gorakhpur; Two Accused Arrested, Third on the Run
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case of molestation and racial harassment involving a female resident doctor has come to light in Gorakhpur. The incident occurred around 8 pm on February 22 when the doctor, a third-year Obstetrics and Gynaecology resident at AIIMS Gorakhpur, was returning from Orion Mall.

body.html:
A case of molestation and racial harassment involving a female resident doctor has come to light in Gorakhpur. The incident occurred around 8 pm on February 22 when the doctor, a third-year Obstetrics and Gynaecology resident at AIIMS Gorakhpur, was returning from Orion Mall.

According to the complaint, three men allegedly stalked the doctor, who hails from Nagaland, for nearly 1.5 kilometres from the mall to Gate No. 2 of AIIMS. They reportedly made lewd comments and racial slurs targeting her northeastern background. One of the accused allegedly removed his shirt to intimidate her.

Near the Army camp close to Gate No. 2, one of the men allegedly inappropriately touched her. The accused fled after the doctor raised an alarm. The incident left her deeply shaken and traumatised.

The matter was reported to the North East Federation of All India Resident Doctors (NAFORD), which strongly condemned the incident. NAFORD stated that the doctor was subjected to severe racial harassment and sexual assault. The organisation wrote to Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, demanding immediate action. It urged the police to promptly register an FIR, examine CCTV footage from Orion Mall and nearby areas, identify and arrest the accused, and ensure security for female doctors and professionals from the Northeast in medical institutions.

NAFORD President Dr Devesh Dubey said the matter had been escalated and that appropriate representation would be made to the Chief Minister’s Office, the Additional Director General (Law and Order), and the Director of AIIMS.

Senior Superintendent of Police Dr Kaustubh confirmed that an FIR had been registered at the AIIMS police station under relevant sections based on the doctor’s complaint. He said CCTV footage had helped identify a motorcycle linked to the accused.

Police have arrested two accused — Suraj Gupta, a resident of Uma Nagar under Kotwali police station area in Deoria, and Amrit Vishwakarma, a resident of Ramnath North in Deoria. A third accused remains absconding, and raids are underway to apprehend him.

Further investigation is in progress.

#Gorakhpur #AIIMS #MolestationCase #WomenSafety #RacialHarassment #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #JusticeForDoctors

articles.title: Land Row Near Deoria Police Post Turns Ugly: Elderly Man, Cop Clash Caught on Camera
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension flared on Sunday afternoon near the Chakra Gosai police post under Mail police station area in Deoria after a land dispute escalated into a scuffle between police personnel and a local resident.

body.html:
Tension flared on Sunday afternoon near the Chakra Gosai police post under Mail police station area in Deoria after a land dispute escalated into a scuffle between police personnel and a local resident.

Dinanath Tiwari, a resident of Chakra Gosai village, has been involved in an ongoing dispute over a plot of land adjacent to the police post and the Panchayat building. On Sunday, he was reportedly getting labourers to clean the area near his house when the outpost inspector and a constable reached the spot and objected to the activity, citing issues related to ownership and demarcation.

The objection led to a heated argument, which soon turned into a physical altercation. Eyewitnesses said that during the scuffle, the elderly man grabbed the inspector’s collar and picked up a brick. Another policeman was seen snatching the brick from his hand. A video of the incident shows other personnel attempting to intervene and defuse the situation.

As the confrontation intensified, members of Tiwari’s family also reached the spot, leading to brief tension in the area.

On receiving information, additional police force from Mail police station arrived and pacified both sides. Station House Officer Arvind Kumar stated that the dispute arose due to a misunderstanding related to the collapse of a wall. He said the situation is now under control and no serious injuries have been reported.

The matter has been reported to senior officials for further review.

articles.title: Daylight Horror in Tarn Taran: Woman Shot at Point-Blank Range, Obsession Angle Suspected
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A residential street in Punjab’s Tarn Taran district witnessed a shocking shooting incident on Saturday evening, leaving a young married woman critically injured. The incident occurred around 4.30 pm in Garden Colony of Patti city.

body.html:
A residential street in Punjab’s Tarn Taran district witnessed a shocking shooting incident on Saturday evening, leaving a young married woman critically injured.

The incident occurred around 4.30 pm in Garden Colony of Patti city. CCTV footage shows a man and a woman travelling on a scooter when another scooter, driven by a man in a red T-shirt identified as Karan, intercepted them.

Karan allegedly stepped off his scooter and began assaulting the man, repeatedly slapping and thrashing him. The woman, identified as Ruby Mehra, attempted to intervene but failed. As the man tried to escape, the accused continued the assault.

When Ruby attempted to flee, Karan allegedly chased her, pulled out a firearm and shot her in the head at close range. The footage shows her collapsing on the road while the accused continued firing multiple rounds before fleeing on his scooter.

Ruby Mehra, who was married a few months ago, was rushed to a private hospital in Amritsar, where she remains in critical condition.

Notably, several vehicles passed through the area during the incident, but none stopped to intervene.

Preliminary investigation indicates that the accused and the victim lived in the same neighbourhood and were known to each other. Police suspect an obsession-driven motive.

“Karan had been harassing Ruby even before her wedding. It appears he could not accept her marriage and fired multiple shots at her,” a police official said.

Police have launched a manhunt to trace the accused. Investigation is underway.

#Punjab #TarnTaran #Patti #Amritsar #CrimeNews #GunViolence #CCTVFootage #BreakingNews

articles.title: UP Jail Warden Dies After Illness; Wife Alleges Leave Denial, Superintendent Refutes Charge
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 45-year-old warder posted at the Mirzapur District Jail died on Sunday evening after his health deteriorated. The deceased, Anand Shukla, was a resident of Haran village under Khetasarai police station area in Jaunpur and had been posted in Mirzapur for the past six months.

body.html:
A 45-year-old warder posted at the Mirzapur District Jail died on Sunday evening after his health deteriorated. The deceased, Anand Shukla, was a resident of Haran village under Khetasarai police station area in Jaunpur and had been posted in Mirzapur for the past six months.

According to jail officials, Shukla had been unwell for the last three days and was initially treated by the jail doctor. On Sunday afternoon, he was reportedly examined by a private physician and returned to his residence. However, around 7 pm, his condition worsened. He was then taken by police personnel to the divisional hospital, where the emergency doctor declared him dead.

Following his death, tension prevailed at the hospital as family members arrived.

Shukla’s wife, Preeti, alleged that her husband had been suffering from tingling in his legs and had sought leave for medical treatment, but the jail administration denied his request. She claimed that due to non-availability of leave, he could not receive proper treatment in time, leading to his death.

Responding to the allegations, Jail Superintendent RP Chaudhary denied any negligence. He stated that Shukla had recently been granted seven days’ leave for his brother-in-law’s wedding and was periodically granted leave as required. He maintained that Shukla was provided medical treatment whenever he fell ill and termed the allegations as baseless.

Further inquiry into the circumstances surrounding the death is awaited.

articles.title: Finance Office Turns Battleground: Self-Proclaimed Bhim Army Leader Accused of Assault, Loot
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A violent altercation at a private finance company branch in Saharanpur’s Behat town has triggered serious allegations, with CCTV footage of the incident now surfacing.

body.html:
A violent altercation at a private finance company branch in Saharanpur’s Behat town has triggered serious allegations, with CCTV footage of the incident now surfacing.

According to a police complaint filed by Johnny Kumar, manager of the Behat branch of Zed Pratham Private Limited, the incident occurred around 11 a.m. on February 21, 2026. The dispute reportedly began when loan holder Vikas, son of Tilakram, received a call from the branch regarding submission of ID documents. The manager alleged that Vikas, claiming links with influential persons, threatened to visit the office and “teach him a lesson.”

Soon after, Vikas allegedly arrived at the branch along with Manjeet Nautiyal — who claims to be the national president of Bhim Army Jai Bhim — and a youth identified as Ankit, accompanied by 8–10 unidentified persons.

As per the complaint and CCTV footage, Manjeet Nautiyal is seen approaching the manager’s desk and kicking it. The manager was allegedly slapped multiple times, while others created chaos inside the office and surrounded the staff.

The complaint further alleges that the accused assaulted and manhandled employees, snatched a gold ring, a necklace, and approximately ₹11,000 from the manager’s purse. Staff members were allegedly held hostage, threatened, and intimidated during the incident. The accused also reportedly issued death threats before leaving the premises.

The manager has demanded strict legal action against the accused. Police at Behat police station have confirmed that CCTV footage and other evidence are being examined.

articles.title: IAF Officer, Father Beaten by Wedding Mob in Bulandshahr After Honking for Way
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serving Indian Air Force (IAF) official and his father were allegedly brutally assaulted by a mob during a wedding procession in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, on February 19, 2026. The incident occurred on Jahangirabad Road during a traditional ‘ghudchadhi’ ceremony.

body.html:
A serving Indian Air Force (IAF) official and his father were allegedly brutally assaulted by a mob during a wedding procession in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, on February 19, 2026.

The incident occurred on Jahangirabad Road during a traditional ‘ghudchadhi’ ceremony. According to the complaint, Pratham and his father, Jitendra Singh, were travelling by car when they encountered a traffic jam caused by a wedding procession. Several participants were reportedly dancing in the middle of the road and holding liquor bottles.

The situation escalated after Jitendra Singh honked to request passage. An argument broke out, and when the father and son objected to alleged verbal abuse, members of the procession allegedly launched a coordinated attack.

Allegations in the Complaint:
Weapons Used: Sticks (dandas) and iron rods
Injuries: Both victims sustained serious injuries; Jitendra Singh reportedly fell unconscious
Theft Claim: A gold chain and wristwatch allegedly went missing during the assault

The injured were initially taken to a nearby hospital and later referred to the district hospital for further treatment.

A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media, drawing widespread condemnation.

Police have registered an FIR against seven named individuals — Ashok Sharma, Akash Sharma, Dharmendra, Sachin, Saurabh, Vishal, and Vivek — along with several unidentified persons.

Station House Officer Sanjesh Kumar stated that both sides have submitted complaints. One accused has been taken into custody and booked for breach of peace, while further legal action will depend on the outcome of the investigation.

#Bulandshahr #UttarPradesh #IAF #RoadRage #WeddingProcession #LawAndOrder #BreakingNews
